mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (lagged 1 month) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of observations when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for the trigger condition is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of observations where PAYEMS growth >0.5% and UNRATE decline >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in <45% of observations with CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and HOUST decline >1.0%, or Rank IC for the conditional signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE (lagged 1 month) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units, it signals a weakening in the housing sector and overall demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of observations when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC for the trigger condition is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflationary pressures that increase equity risk premiums, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of observations with INDPRO decline >0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise >0.2pp, or the interaction term coefficient is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenues, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS (lagged 1 month) and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
